hooks.command: mkdir -p .claude && jq -r '.prompt // empty' | { read -r p; if [ "$p" = "/clear" ]; then if [ -s .claude/last-prompt.log ]; then { printf '\n---- %s ----\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"; cat .claude/last-prompt.log; } >> .claude/prompt-history.log; fi; else printf '%s' "$p" > .claude/last-prompt.log; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
